parts.cue: Turn the crank slowly and watch the piston follow the rod.
parts.description: Slides in the bore to change cylinder volume, carrying rings that seal mixture during strokes.
parts.name: Piston

parts.cue: Turn the crank and see both ends stay joined while angling.
parts.description: Joins piston pin to crank pin, converting reciprocating motion to rotation throughout the cycle.
parts.name: Connecting Rod

parts.cue: Rotate the crank through two full turns to complete one cycle.
parts.description: Rotates with counterweight to carry the crank pin around, driving piston position each stroke.
parts.name: Crankshaft

strokes.caption: Piston descends, intake valve open, fresh mixture enters the cylinder.
strokes.name: Intake
strokes.narration: Piston descends with intake open, drawing fresh mixture in as chamber volume grows.

strokes.caption: Both valves closed; rising piston compresses the trapped mixture.
strokes.name: Compression
strokes.narration: Both valves close as the piston rises, compressing trapped mixture before spark.

strokes.caption: Spark at top; both closed; expanding gas drives piston downward.
strokes.name: Power
strokes.narration: Spark occurs near top with both valves closed; expanding gas pushes piston down.

strokes.caption: Exhaust open; rising piston expels burnt gas from cylinder.
strokes.name: Exhaust
strokes.narration: Exhaust opens as piston rises, expelling burnt gas; two turns complete cycle.

structured.subtitle: Follow four strokes across two crank turns in a cutaway
structured.title: Four-Stroke Spark Engine Cycle
